name: Enterprise Fund Committee Meeting Agenda January 17, 2024
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE

  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA FOR THE
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  January 17, 2024 - 6:00 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall West - Conference Room A
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Meeting Minutes of October 11, 2023

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS
  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.
  A) Sewer Rate Study Report Presentation & Discussion (Raftelis)
  B) Water Department User Fee Report Presentation (Finance)
  C) Staff Update
  D) Operations Update

7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

8.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted on January 10, 2024 at 2:55 p.m.
